description: issue #679 (SP7): the reserved-word rule covers struct CONSTRUCTORS as well as procedures (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154 — "as variables, procedures, or struct constructors"), so with `sprites` active `struct tell`/`struct ask`/`struct each` each raise `ol-reserved-word` at the struct-name token. Scope note, corrected: when this fixture was written the `variables` third of that sentence was NOT diagnosed (`:tell = 1` checked clean) and was reported to @orchestrator rather than fixed here, parser source being outside #679's write-set. Epic-Gate finding B3 took that up as issue #739, which closed the gap — `:tell = 1` now raises `ol-reserved-word` too, proven by the sibling fixture reserved-bindings-with-sprites. All three cases spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154 names (variables, procedures, struct constructors) are therefore covered; this fixture owns the struct-constructor third.

diagnostics.message: tell is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
ask is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
